turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently only ship within the United States and to select regions in Canada, so we do not ship to other international countries outside those areas.

Here’s how it works:

Where we ship
Contiguous United States: All products
Alaska & Hawaii: Select products only
Canada: Select items to limited regions (not Yukon, Northwest Territories, or Nunavut)
Customs, duties, and fees for Canada
There are no additional fees you need to pay on top of what you see at checkout.
All required duties, taxes, and certifications (including phytosanitary certification) are already included in the prices and shipping charges shown in Canadian checkout.
You do not need to arrange any separate paperwork or pay customs charges on delivery.

If you tell me what country you’re in, I can confirm whether shipping is possible to your specific location.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Transit time is usually pretty quick, but it works a little differently than a typical “order today, ships whenever” setup.

For most orders:

In checkout, you choose an estimated arrival date (US) or ship week (Canada) from our delivery calendar. Those options already factor in our processing time plus standard carrier transit time.
Within the contiguous US, carrier transit is typically about 1–5 business days once the order leaves our nursery.
For eligible regions in Canada, orders ship during your selected ship week and usually arrive the following week.

We use standard ground shipping only, and all dates shown at checkout are estimates, since weather or carrier delays can occasionally affect timing.

If you share whether you’re in the US or Canada and what you’re planning to order (roses, bulbs, perennials), I can give you a more tailored expectation.
